title: Arc celebratory name card: personal poster after onboarding
note: Lydia: celebratory personal name card after onboarding from Arc browser company. A cream card on a pale background with faint concentric rings. A rust-orange blob with a scalloped right edge fills the top, then her name in bold red (Lydia) with MAJESTIC PSYCHIC in small tracked caps underneath. At the bottom, a red outlined pill holds ARC, a hatched square, and the date Oct 3, 2026, with BROWSER COMPANY stacked in red caps on the right. Share, download, and copy icons sit below the card. The reward for finishing onboarding is a printable-feeling personal artifact, not a checklist.
